author: SHADOW6six
Grok
description: Automatic personal voice rooms (VoidRooms). Join a source channel to create a room named after you or your current game. Supports normal/locked/private modes, ownership transfer, allow/remove, and auto-delete when empty. Inspired by AutoRoom.
install_msg: VoidRooms installed! Use `[p]voidroomsset source <vc> <category>` to configure. Author: SHADOW6six + Grok (inspired by autoroom).
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores room ownership and configuration data (channel IDs, owner IDs, room type) in Red's Config. No external data is collected.
